name: research
description: Research records for a coding agent, changed through transitions and held together by a check: ideas, questions, tasks and findings as typed Markdown records, a reference library that refuses an unread citation, a dashboard over both, and the method a session works by.

interface.shortDescription: Typed research records, a reference library, a dashboard and the method.
interface.longDescription: The flow of ideas, tasks, questions and findings as one Markdown record each, moved by transitions through the `flow` CLI and validated by a check; one card per referred work with read grades and extracts through the `library` CLI; one read-only dashboard over both; and the method rules a session works by.
defaultPrompt: Use research to read the records and pick up the next item.
Use research to register the work I just cited in the reference library.
